response.sql: SELECT AVG(media_type_average) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_average FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 AND t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name) AS media_type_averages

assumptions.assumption: “Pass a file-size cutoff” means Bytes is strictly greater than 10,323,804. The average is calculated per media type name, then those averages are averaged equally; missing Bytes or Milliseconds values are excluded.
